objective: Functional parity with Hatchet TypeScript SDK v1 while preserving Rust-native design.
target_outcome: Declare workflows/tasks/durable tasks with equivalent semantics.
Run/schedule/cron/bulk-run workflows with equivalent run options.
Run workers against real Hatchet engine, including cancellation and durable flows.
Use context and durable context methods with real backend behavior.
Use feature clients (runs/workflows/workers/etc.) against real API.
Keep Rust-first design (typed APIs, Result errors, trait-based transport, no JS runtime patterns).
ground_rules: Keep InMemoryTransport and existing tests working.
Add parity through additive gRPC/REST-backed paths.
Preserve Rust API ergonomics while adding TS-equivalent capability.
Do not remove existing public items unless replaced compatibly.
current_gaps_confirmed: gRPC workflow registration drops rate limits/worker labels/concurrency/slot requests.
Worker action loop ignores cancel actions.
Durable listener is not integrated into runtime durable path.
Durable eviction path is not integrated end-to-end.
Feature clients are mostly in-memory, not REST-backed.
Workflow handle lacks run_many + schedule/delay/cron helpers.
Run options do not support full desired worker label fidelity.
Health server is not integrated with worker lifecycle.

tasks.title: Complete gRPC workflow registration payload parity
steps: Fill rendered_to_proto_task mappings for rate_limits, worker_labels, concurrency, slot_requests, backoff_factor, backoff_max_seconds.
Ensure WorkflowRegistration::from_declaration carries all required fields.
Add tests asserting these proto fields are populated and not defaulted away.
acceptance_criteria: No TODO placeholders remain in task proto conversion.
Regression tests fail if any mapped field is dropped.

tasks.title: Add real run stream and log retrieval paths
steps: Implement GrpcTransport::stream_run() from real source (listener or REST).
Implement GrpcTransport::list_logs() with real backend call.
Ensure LogsClient::list() returns real records in grpc mode.
acceptance_criteria: WorkflowRunRef::stream() returns non-empty events for streamed tasks.
logs().list() returns engine logs for real runs.

tasks.title: Handle cancel actions in worker action loop
steps: Handle cancel action type in handle_assigned_action.
Track running task contexts by task-run id and trigger cancellation token on cancel.
Ensure completion reporting after cancellation is correct (cancelled/failed, no false success).
acceptance_criteria: Engine-issued cancel stops long-running task code path.
Cancellation regression test verifies no unintended completion event after cancel.

tasks.title: Implement refresh_timeout and release_slot end-to-end
steps: Extend Transport trait with refresh_timeout(task_run_id, increment) and release_slot(task_run_id).
Replace context no-op methods with transport calls.
Keep explicit no-op fallback in InMemoryTransport.
Implement dispatcher RPC calls in GrpcTransport.
acceptance_criteria: Context methods affect real worker scheduling behavior in grpc mode.
In-memory tests remain green.

tasks.title: Correct worker action identity mapping
steps: Validate action_id/task_name/registry-key usage in dispatcher handling.
Fix lookup to use the exact registered action key expected by engine.
Add regression test for action-id mismatch.
acceptance_criteria: Worker runs simple and namespaced task actions without key mismatch.

tasks.title: Integrate DurableListenerClient into runtime durable context
steps: Introduce engine-backed durable context type separate from in-memory context.
Route durable worker execution to engine-backed context in grpc mode.
Implement durable operations using request/ack/callback stream flow.
acceptance_criteria: Durable wait_for and spawn_children survive worker restart semantics via engine.

tasks.title: Add durable listener reconnection and callback durability
steps: Implement reconnect with backoff on stream close/error.
Rehydrate pending ack/callback waiters across reconnect boundaries.
Add timeout/error semantics matching TS expectations.
acceptance_criteria: Stream interruption does not orphan in-flight durable waits.

tasks.title: Wire serverEvict into eviction manager
steps: Forward server eviction notices from durable listener to eviction manager.
Track active vs waiting durable states and apply correct eviction behavior.
Emit local cancellation and engine acknowledgment/reporting as needed.
acceptance_criteria: Eviction paths are deterministic and test-covered.

tasks.title: Implement parent condition engine-backed durable resolution
steps: Replace current parent-condition unsupported runtime path with engine-backed wait flow.
Ensure parent condition expressions and readable-data-key behavior align with renderer.
acceptance_criteria: Durable parent conditions execute without runtime errors in grpc mode.

tasks.title: Expand RunOpts worker-label fidelity
steps: Upgrade RunOpts desired_worker_labels from flat map to rich config (value/required/weight/comparator).
Preserve backward compatibility for old serialized format where possible.
Map fields through trigger RPC conversion.
acceptance_criteria: Run trigger supports full desired label routing semantics.

tasks.title: Add workflow handle parity helpers
steps: Add WorkflowHandle::run_many(waiting variant).
Add schedule/delay/cron convenience APIs on workflow handle.
Keep existing feature-client methods and avoid duplication ambiguity.
acceptance_criteria: Users can execute TS-style workflow helper flows from workflow handle API.

tasks.title: Support durable steps in workflow declaration
steps: Add APIs to place DurableTaskHandle steps in workflow DAG.
Carry durable marker into registration and execution paths.
Ensure registration sets is_durable for durable steps.
acceptance_criteria: Mixed durable/non-durable DAG declaration and execution works.

tasks.title: Add workflow-level input schema parity
steps: Add optional workflow input schema field on declaration.
Serialize and send schema as input_json_schema during registration.
acceptance_criteria: Engine receives workflow input schema in grpc mode.

tasks.title: Implement lifecycle hook registration parity (on_failure/on_success)
ts_mapping: worker-internal.ts synthetic on-success task with leaf parents
steps: Map on_failure into CreateWorkflowVersionRequest.on_failure_task.
Implement on_success via synthetic terminal step with all DAG leaves as parents.
Apply task defaults and serialization parity.
acceptance_criteria: Failure and success handlers execute in engine, not only stored in declaration.

tasks.title: Introduce real REST-backed feature client mode
steps: Add backend enum per feature client (InMemory vs Rest).
Build shared authenticated REST client path.
Retain in-memory mode for tests and local deterministic behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Feature client operations reflect live engine state in grpc/rest mode.

tasks.title: Improve runs client parity
ts_mapping: features/runs.ts filter list/cancel/replay + durable helpers + stream utility
steps: Add filter-based run operations in addition to direct-id methods.
Align restore/branch/get_task_external_id semantics with TS.
Align streaming helper behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Runs client supports TS-equivalent operational workflows.

tasks.title: Implement workers feature parity for pause lifecycle
steps: Add workers feature methods for paused status and state changes via API.
Keep local WorkerHandle pause/unpause APIs and document local vs remote behavior.
acceptance_criteria: client.workers() supports TS-equivalent pause lifecycle operations.

tasks.title: Close parity for logs/schedules/crons/metrics/filters/webhooks
steps: Audit each Rust feature client method against TS semantics and arguments.
Fill missing methods and behavior mismatches.
Add parity tests per feature client.
acceptance_criteria: Method-level parity matrix is complete and test-backed.

tasks.title: Integrate health server into worker lifecycle
steps: Add optional health server startup in WorkerBuilder/Worker start path.
Update health state on worker lifecycle transitions.
Stop health server during shutdown.
acceptance_criteria: Health endpoint reflects live worker state for running worker.

tasks.title: Add wait_until_ready worker readiness helper
steps: Add readiness API waiting for successful registration/listen startup.
Use timeout with typed error result.
acceptance_criteria: Callers can block until readiness without ad-hoc sleeps.

tasks.title: Add cancellation supervision and diagnostics
steps: Add cancellation grace monitoring for non-cooperative task code.
Emit structured warnings/errors when tasks ignore cancellation.
acceptance_criteria: Cancellation failure modes are observable and test-covered.

tasks.title: Apply retry policy to all transient gRPC calls
steps: Ensure all safe transient network calls use retry policy.
Define explicit non-retryable status set.
Expose jitter and max-elapsed controls.
acceptance_criteria: Retry behavior is consistent and configurable.

tasks.title: Standardize error mapping and context
steps: Normalize transport/domain errors with rich context.
Add error variants for durable callback timeout, listener disconnect, unsupported operation mode.
acceptance_criteria: Production errors are actionable and unambiguous.

tasks.title: Create real engine integration suite
ts_mapping: End-to-end operational behavior equivalent to TS runtime flows
steps: Add dockerized test harness for Hatchet engine.
Add integration tests for register/run/output, child runs, cancellation, durable wait/memo/spawn, stream/log retrieval, feature client REST operations.
acceptance_criteria: cargo test --workspace --features integration passes locally and in CI.

tasks.title: Add parity contract tests keyed by TS function rows
ts_mapping: All mapped TS surfaces in this document
rust_files: parity contract test files (to be added)
steps: Add parity matrix test file keyed by TS function names.
Require at least one test per parity row.
Fail CI if row unimplemented or ignored without issue reference.
acceptance_criteria: Parity status is machine-checkable.

api_and_data_model_changes_required: Expand Transport trait for timeout/slot control and required lifecycle hooks.
Add workflow declaration support for durable DAG steps.
Add optional workflow input schema field.
Add worker readiness and health APIs.

milestones.name: Production non-durable baseline
exit_criteria: Non-durable workflows run reliably on real engine.
Cancellation and stream/log behavior are real, not stubs.

milestones.name: Durable production baseline
exit_criteria: Durable operations are engine-backed and restart-safe.

milestones.name: Full feature/client parity
exit_criteria: SDK capabilities are functionally equivalent to TS v1 for supported surfaces.
